svg.text: Fictional patient Elena Vasquez. Not a real record.
Continue lisinopril 10 mg tablet. Take 1 tablet by mouth every morning at 8:00.
Acetaminophen 500 mg tablet. Take 1 tablet by mouth every 8 hours as needed for pain.
Continue cholecalciferol 1000 IU capsule. Take 1 capsule by mouth once daily at 8:00.
Start cephalexin 500 mg capsule. Take 1 capsule by mouth at 8:00, 14:00, 20:00, and 2:00 for 7 days.
Stop aspirin 81 mg delayed release tablet.
